Definition was stated as no duty; it sets the scope of the MAH duty in Article 54(2) to collect, analyse and report suspected abnormal reactions to vaccination, so the statement now states that scope.

row.title: Scope of abnormal reactions to vaccination covered by MAH monitoring and reporting duties
row.statement: For the MAH's duties on suspected abnormal reactions to vaccination, such a reaction is an adverse drug reaction in which a qualified vaccine, during or after standard vaccination, damages the vaccinee's tissues, organs or functions with no party at fault. Excluded are common reactions from the vaccine's inherent properties, harm from quality problems or from the vaccination unit's breach of norms, coincidental disease onset, aggravation of a pre-existing disease where contraindications were not disclosed, and psychogenic reactions.
